fields.description: A smoky fever causes the {{ status_effect:feverish.name }} status effect and sensitivity to open flame.
A damp cough and shortness of breath associated with stagnant wetlands.
A draining intestinal illness marked by cramps, thirst, and rapid weakness.
A painful dry cough that produces tiny translucent crystals of uncertain origin.
Increasing bouts of sleep interrupt ordinary activity and become difficult to resist.
Numb, discolored tissue spreads after prolonged cold or supernatural exposure.
An invasive fungus causes vivid dreams and the {{ status_effect:confused.name }} status effect.
Darkened veins slowly spread from an infected wound as strength fades.
A visible mark reacts whenever the bearer approaches breaking a sworn promise.
Reflections occasionally act out intentions the bearer has tried to conceal.
Ordinary meals no longer bring lasting satisfaction, regardless of abundance.
Each deep sleep leaves part of the body briefly cold, heavy, and stone-like.
A hidden mark repeats fragments of nearby secrets when the surroundings are quiet.
Recurring dreams connect the bearer to a place, object, or unknown sleeper.
Delicate plants and perishable goods deteriorate unusually quickly in the bearer’s hands.
The bearer’s shadow sometimes follows movements belonging to someone else.
